questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The vendor sold the vegetables in the market.

options.text: The vegetables are sold by the vendor in the market.
The vegetables were being sold by the vendor in the market.
The vegetables were sold by the vendor in the market.
The vendor had sold the vegetables in the market.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"The vegetables were sold by the vendor in the market"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in a declarative form.
 
• As per the given question, we have to change it to passive voice.
 
• An action in a sentence can be represented in two ways, namely active and passive voice.
 
• The passive voice always uses the past participle form of the main verb irrespective of any tense.
 
• Only the auxiliary verbs depend upon the sentence given in the active voice.
 
 
• **Example:** *He reads a novel.*
 
 
 
• The above sentence is in active voice.
 
 
• **Example:** *A novel is read by him.*
 
 
 
• The above sentence is in passive voice.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, the correct answer is **option 3.**

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Food blogs are often authored by food aficionados, sometimes known as ‘foodies’.

B. The blogger can benefit from it if he or she uses it professionally.

C. Food blogging is food journalism that combines an interest in food, blog writing, and food photography.

D. The greater the popularity of a food blogger, the more options for him/her to monetise his/her work.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"CABD"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sentence C should come first as it is the opening of the paragraph. 
 
• Sentence A is the second sentence as it states that food blogs are authored by food aficionados.
 
• Sentence B is the third sentence as it states the benefits of being a food blogger.
 
• Sentence D comes at the end as it states the popularity of the blogger, and also provides a conclusion of the paragraph.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The paragraph after the re-arrangement is as follows:
 
• Food blogging is food journalism that combines an interest in food, blog writing, and food photography. Food blogs are often authored by food aficionados, sometimes known as ‘foodies’. The blogger can benefit from it if he or she uses it professionally. The greater the popularity of a food blogger, the more options for him/her to monetize his/her work.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The problem will be solved by my friend.

options.text: My friend was solved the problem.
My friend will be solving the problem.
My friend will solve the problem.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is, '**My friend will solve the problem**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Active and Passive rules say that a subject of a Passive sentence changes to an object in an Active sentence.
 
 
• Example - Passive Voice: ***The car was driven by Jake***. Active Voice: ***Jake drove the car***.
 
 
 
• The Simple Future sentences (will + 1st form of the verb) of Active voice are turned into Passive voice sentences by using 'will + be + 2nd form of the verb'.
 
 
• Example - Active Voice: ***Millie will take the ring***. Passive voice: ***The ring will be taken by Millie***.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The following table shows changes in the Active and Passive forms of verb:

 
 

 **Tenses**
 **Verbs in Active form **
 **Verbs in Passive form **
 
 

 Simple Present
 Send
 Is sent 
 
 

 Simple Past 
 Sent
 Was sent 
 
 

 
 
Simple Future 

 
 Will send 
 Will be sent
 
 

 Present Continuous
 Is sending
 Is being sent
 
 

 Past Continuous
 Was sending
 Was being sent
 
 

 Present Perfect
 Has sent
 Has been sent
 
 

 Past Perfect
 Had sent
 Had been sent

• The correct sentence would be, **Women must be accorded equal rights and opportunities in all fields, regardless of their gender.**

• **Taken** means** to take**.

 
 
• Example -*** Brian has taken the car for a spin***.
 
 
 
• **Accepted** means** to come to terms with or agree**.
 
 
• Example - ***The management agreed to the employee's demands.***
 
 
 
• **Satisfied with** means **happy**.
 
 
• Example - ***Tom seems very satisfied with his new car.***
